release_notes:
Speed up dashboard, package edit, and catalog pages under load

Sargable date-range rewrites (was YEAR()/MONTH()/DATE()-wrapped WHERE
clauses, which block any index) plus new indexes for the dashboard's
order/profit/chart queries and the recent-orders feed, which used to
join and sort all three full order tables before limiting to 10.
Also fixes the checkbox-flash on service edit pages before sliders
init, narrows the catalog price-lookup queries, and adds a filter to
the Supplier Service picker.
